facts.fact: The Public Procurement and Property Administration Authority says its electronic government procurement platform was used by 172 federal institutions and 196 branch offices in fiscal year 2025/26.
The Authority says the e-GP system automates bidding, evaluation, contract signing and payment.
The Authority's Director General says more than 597 billion birr in completed transactions went through the e-GP platform in fiscal year 2025/26.
